name: timestamp
description: Server-side wall-clock at which the audit row was inserted. Used as the partition column.

name: agent_id
description: agentId (UUID) the event belongs to. Null for pre-auth failures (e.g. unknown token, missing bearer).

name: user_id
description: Owning userId. Null for pre-auth failures.

name: event_type
description: One of the AgentAuthEvent eventType variants: auth_success | auth_success_previous_hash | auth_failed_no_token | auth_failed_no_match | auth_failed_revoked | auth_failed_unknown_token | agent_registered | token_rotated | agent_revoked.

name: ip
description: Client IP as seen by the api (post-trustProxy). Null when the request did not carry a recognisable IP (e.g. internal injection).

name: user_agent
description: Raw User-Agent header. Null when absent.

name: success
description: True for the success and lifecycle event types; false for any auth_failed_* variant. Derived server-side from event_type so the column is queryable without a CASE expression.

name: latency_ms
description: Time the agent-token-guard spent processing the request, milliseconds. Null when the event was emitted outside the guard (lifecycle events from route handlers).

name: error_code
description: Short stable identifier for failure reason; opaque free-form string for now.

name: metadata
description: Forward-compatibility envelope. Currently always null; reserved for structured supplemental context (rotation result code, previous-hash usage count delta, anomaly scores) without a schema migration.
